tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). Actions taken: identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production). First rollback attempt to v2.3.0 halted with a partial failure after us-east (orchestrator error), leaving us-east on v2.3.0 and us-west/eu-west on v2.3.1. Retried the rollback to v2.3.0, which completed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback status: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial failure during rollback; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed without change-manager review.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and it's healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Target version:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release marked healthy in production. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production.
- **Rollback:** The first attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving us-east on v2.3.0 and the other two regions on v2.3.1. I retried the rollback to v2.3.0, and it completed in all regions.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call. The first attempt to create it timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key. It was created once.

Follow-ups for the incident:
- Investigate why v2.3.1 failed health checks.
- Investigate the orchestrator partial failure during the first rollback attempt.
- Don't redeploy v2.3.1 without change-manager review.
